_comment: PRIOR-RESIDUAL CENSUS (docs/SPEC_prior_residual_census.md) -- the measure-only arm.
Extends _ft63_pdfix_v3.json; the ONLY delta vs _ft63_prires_off.json is
network.prior_residual_census (plus the run paths).  MEASURE-ONLY: no gate, no
deweight, no exclusion, no refloat -- report_sigma is a TRACE threshold and
nothing reads it back, so the solve must be byte-identical to the OFF arm.
FINGERPRINT STATUS: SAFE (no solve effect, no snapshot field), so this arm is
legal on a WARM RESUME.  The sigma0 accumulator is deliberately NOT snapshotted
in v1 -- a resumed run restarts it empty and reports RAW FORMAL for the first
window, which is acceptable only because every row and every ladder row says so
(sigma0_warm = 0, n_raw_formal > 0).  Never read a cold ladder as a calibrated one.
FAMILIES: all five are armed so the run-end line INVENTORIES which carried stiff
priors actually have a live carry on this lineage -- that inventory IS the card's
deliverable, and a zero-row family is a reported result, not a failure.  On THIS
lineage, expected:
* cb   -- LIVE.  estimate_sat_code_bias + code_datum_time_linked are on.  This
is the family the card exists for: the DOY-129 pivot-CB ratchet
(q_cb = 1e-10 => 49 m step, tau = 3.79 h) was a stiff prior carrying
a stale value with NO screen on it.
* rxcb -- LIVE.  carry_rx_code_bias is on and sits OUTSIDE the carry_warm
bracket by design, so it runs on this no-phase-leveling lineage.
* pb   -- MAY BE EMPTY.  Under carry_invariant the shared PhaseBias carry is
not in prev_carry; if it reports zero rows that is a property of the
lineage, not of the wiring.  Check the run-end line, which says which.
* pl, zwd -- STRUCTURALLY INERT HERE.  Both harvests sit inside the carry_warm
bracket and carry_warm = phase_leveling && ..., and this lineage runs
carry_invariant WITHOUT phase_leveling.  They are armed deliberately
so the run-end WARN names them; grade them on a phase_leveling
lineage instead.
CONVERGENCE HYGIENE (spec section 9, learned from the redundancy census's cold
smoke): BOTH the statistic and its calibration are structurally distorted during
convergence.  This 3 h COLD run establishes gates 1 (OFF byte-identity), 2 (live
wiring / non-zero rows per armed family) and 7 (cost) and gives a FIRST READ of
the ladders.  Gates 3 (the positive control), 4 (the cb known answer), 5 (the pl
ladder) and 6 (the contingency table) require a CONVERGED WARM window -- chain
this arm onto a seed leg by pointing state_snapshot_path at the seed's snapshot
(legal: the card is fingerprint-SAFE) and grade only the resumed leg.  A report
that quotes gates 3-6 off a cold run is quoting convergence, not the statistic.
DURABILITY: only health_trace flushes mid-run; the census flushes
network_prior_residual.csv on the content-hour roll, and health_interval_s = 300
is already inherited, so a killed run keeps whole hours of the ladder.
